verdict.rationale: Vercel's marketplace lists Neon as a serverless Postgres option with 'autoscaling and instant branching' provisioned via Vercel, but no documented mention of point-in-time recovery, read replicas, or high-availability configurations. A community comment also notes that going beyond password-based DB connections requires 'contacting sales' for enterprise features, suggesting deeper HA/security options aren't self-serve. missing for 10: explicit documentation of point-in-time recovery, replica support, and HA guarantees for a Vercel-provisioned Postgres database.
